Sixty years ago Shastriji Maharaj's suvarna tula mahotsav was celebrated in Atladra by thousands of devotees. They weighed Shastriji Maharaj with sugar crystals. In memory of that landmark celebration a symbolic tula was carried out on that very spot with the utsav murti of Shastriji Maharaj. Swamishri placed sugar crystals on the pan opposite that of Shastriji Maharaj's utsav murti. He also blessed youths and devotees who were dressed as devotees in the time of Shastriji Maharaj.
